responsibility: This header declares the mc-boot runtime's ASCII text case-conversion utilities. It exports procedures to copy strings to upper or lower case and character-level Cap and Lower operations, defining the public interface for case mapping separate from the broader StrLib string helpers.
same_name_distinction: This .h file is the declaration side of the GStrCase pair, exposing the StrToUpperCase, StrToLowerCase, Cap, and Lower entry points, while gcc/m2/mc-boot/GStrCase.cc holds the actual case-conversion code.
